analyst.summary: SKF India (Industrial) is the newly separated industrial-bearings arm of SKF India, spun off from the automotive bearings business in October 2025. Its recent quarters show large swings -- including a reported net loss last quarter -- but these are mostly one-off demerger and separation costs layered on comparisons against a pre-demerger combined base, not a deterioration of the underlying business, which remains debt-free and high-return. We rate it a Hold: a quality franchise, but one whose reported numbers need a few more clean quarters before they can be read straightforwardly, and current pricing already reflects a normalized recovery.
